profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at New Jersey Department of the Treasury
profile.summary:
Senior Full Stack .NET Developer and Technical Lead with 19+ years of strong hands-on experience building and delivering enterprise applications across Financial Services, Digital Banking, Insurance, Healthcare, Education, and Retail.

Strong expertise in C#, .NET, .NET Core, ASP.NET, Web API, REST, Entity Framework, SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, Angular, and TypeScript, with a solid foundation in enterprise architecture, solution design, Design Patterns, SOLID principles, Azure, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, security, and performance optimization.

Experienced in leading technical solutions across the full SDLC—from requirements and architecture through development, code reviews, testing, deployment, and production support. Known for taking ownership, solving complex technical challenges, mentoring developers, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering secure, scalable, maintainable, and high-performing solutions aligned with business goals.
